Ideas · Bring Ideas Together
              
              What I noticedOne sentence combines words from more than one earlier section. The comparison does not prove the sentence brings the ideas together.
              Look at your writingNo passage could be verified in your current text, so nothing is marked. Read the ending with the earlier sections and check the connection.
              What's working
              Why it mattersAn ending works when readers see what your points add up to. Combining ideas from earlier sections is one way to show that.
              How to improveRead the highlighted sentence with the earlier sections. Check that it connects those ideas as you intend, and adjust the wording in your own words if the connection is unclear.
              This check compares wording between sections. It cannot judge whether the combined meaning works.
